title: Practical circuit representations and sources
concepts_taught: Recognise the prescribed circuit components from their symbols.
Translate between a written circuit description and a connected circuit diagram.
Interpret e.m.f. as source energy supplied per unit charge.
Interpret potential difference as energy transferred from charge per unit charge between two points.
Model a real source as an e.m.f. with internal resistance.
Relate terminal p.d. to e.m.f. and the voltage lost inside the source.
skills_students_can_now_use: Draw and interpret circuit diagrams using the prescribed symbols.
Define e.m.f. as energy transferred per unit charge around a complete circuit.
Distinguish e.m.f. from potential difference using energy transfers.
Explain why a source’s terminal p.d. changes when it supplies current.
Use e.m.f., current and internal resistance to determine terminal p.d. and lost volts.
